purpose: Multi-wavelength register candidates placed on the Rubin frame they fall inside, so a flagged position can be seen on the sky image rather than read from a table.
method: Sky position converted through the WCS of the reconciled product the previews were drawn from. Candidates without a recorded region are matched by asking which frame contains the position.
meaning: A marker means an operator flagged this position, not that anything is there. The register holds 34 candidates out of 12,954 comparisons and none is confirmed by a second operator.
